name: Hy3
tagline: Tencent finally drops the community license — mind which checkpoint you grab
description: Tencent Hunyuan's 295B-total / 21B-active MoE reasoner (192 experts, top-8, plus a 3.8B multi-token-prediction layer) with 256K context — released under plain Apache-2.0, a first for the Hunyuan line. Official 1-bit and 4-bit GGUF builds put a flagship-scale model on a single GPU via llama.cpp.
why: GLM-5.2-class results at less than half the total parameters — 78.0 SWE-Bench Verified, 90.4 GPQA-Diamond — and Tencent's switch from its restrictive community license to Apache-2.0 is a genuine licensing policy shift worth rewarding with attention.
useCases: Near-frontier local inference on a single big GPU via official GGUFs
audience: Teams priced out of trillion-parameter hosting; local-AI enthusiasts

setup.requirements: FP8/BF16 want a multi-GPU node; the official 1-bit/4-bit GGUFs with MTP run on one GPU under llama.cpp

license.notes: The earlier Hy3-preview repo still carries the Tencent Hunyuan Community License — void in the EU/UK/South Korea, 100M-MAU commercial cap, and a no-training-on-outputs clause. Only the official Hy3 checkpoints are Apache. Check which one you're pulling.

tally.stars: Release repo weeks old; official GGUF builds already shipped

limitations: Coding trails GLM-5.2 in head-to-heads, the release lineage is brand new with little independent evaluation, and the aggressive 1-bit quantizations cost real quality.
take: Every Hunyuan release used to come with a map of where you couldn't use it. This one just comes with weights.
